Moonshake is our oat stout brewed with English Maris Otter malt, a rich blend of caramel and chocolate malts, and a massive amount of oats. data.name: 13. TIME LAPSE FH WC IPA- KINGS & DAUGHTERS
data.short_description:
Hood River, OR; 7.1%

Fresh Hop – Coleman Farms Grown Indie Strata

Hop farming is an act of patience, resilience, and faith in the season. PNW brewers know this well — watching bines come and go and come again as the calendar ticks toward harvest, counting the days until that brief, electric window opens. Time Lapse, a Fresh Hop West Coast IPA, honors that wait. A tribute to the farmers who roll with the punches each season throws, and to the hops they coax from the earth — captured at peak freshness, once a year, and never quite the same twice. Fresh hop hot side additions of Coleman Strata. FInished with Nelson Hop Oil, Simcoe & Strata t90, Citra Cryo

data.name: PILSENER - JEVER 16.9oz can
data.short_description:
GER; 4.9%, 40 IBU

We use only the best brewing water, in order to ensure the unique taste of Jever Pilsener. As long ago as 1898, Theodor Fetköter had a pipeline laid to the brewery, 4 km away from Jever, for that purpose. What makes our brewing water special is that it contains only a small amount of limestone, making it particularly soft.
